name: kipping muscle up
description: A kipping muscle-up on rings that uses a controlled swing to move from a hang to a support above the rings.
instructions: Hang from two rings with a secure grip and straight arms.
Create a small, controlled kip from your hips and trunk rather than a large uncontrolled swing.
Pull the rings toward your chest, then lean your chest forward between them to transition above the rings.
Press down on the rings until your arms are straight, then lower under control.
